items.text: Denver (TBD): S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle, expected to miss multiple weeks), S Brandon Jones (hamstring). On IR: RB RJ Harvey (Week 13), RB Tyler Badie, OLB Jonah Elliss; WR Pat Bryant eligible Week 9. Bo Nix is the starter (no QB acquisition planned).

Carolina (TBD): LB Jaelan Phillips (hamstring), CB Will Lee III (hamstring), G Damien Lewis (knee), C Corey Bullock (quad); G Torricelli Simpkins III and DT Bobby Brown III missed Week 8. On IR: OT Taylor Moton (season), OT Ikem Ekwonu (PUP), CB Jaycee Horn, CB Mike Jackson, WR Xavier Legette. Brady Christensen's IR practice window opened.
